verdict.rationale: Bento documents Segments as saved filters that automatically add people when they match and remove them when they no longer do, with no backfill step (bento-docs-42, bento-docs-66). It also describes a custom segment builder with unlimited conditions (bento-docs-26) and says events are captured to help build segments (bento-docs-27). Tag and last-event filtering appear in subscriber search (bento-docs-8), and custom fields and tags are documented as profile data (bento-docs-40, bento-docs-45). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that segment conditions can target custom field values, tags, and specific event properties; independent or hands-on corroboration of segment behavior.
